name: Tinker’s Gift
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 3/legendary alchemist 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components v, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours

DESCRIPTION

This extract is mixed with the rare poison of the crimson scorpion prepared in an incredibly exacting fashion, creating an invigorating link between the alchemist and their automaton.

As long as you are under the effects of tinker gift, once per round when your automaton makes a successful attack, combat maneuver against an opponent with a CR of at least 1/2 your level, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your two times Intelligence modifier which last for the duration of this spell. For the spell’s duration, you gain a +2 alchemical bonus on all saving throws.
